title: Reimbursement to counties.
bodyText: The counties shall be reimbursed the incremental costs incurred in the administration of this part. The amount of reimbursement shall be determined by the director of transportation.
bodyHtml: [§286-313]  Reimbursement to counties.  The counties shall be reimbursed the incremental costs incurred in the administration of this part.  The amount of reimbursement shall be determined by the director of transportation. [L 2012, c 310, pt of §2]
